title: Dual-Graph Generation of Tautological Relations
exact_target: Let $\mathcal S_{g,n}$ be the strata algebra and let $\mathcal R\subset\mathcal S_{g,n}$ be the ideal generated by pullbacks and pushforwards of the dual-graph relations $R(g,n,r)$. Is $\mathcal R$ exactly the kernel of the natural surjection $\mathcal S_{g,n}\to R^*(\overline{\mathcal M}_{g,n})$? Do the analogous completeness statements hold after restriction to compact-type and rational-tail loci?
